1.explanation: The issue is related to the Cascader component displaying title information (tooltips) for items. The 'Cascader' class in 'cascader.jsx' is the main component managing the cascader logic and would need to expose a new API/prop to control the presence of title info. The 'CascaderMenuItem' class in 'item.jsx' is responsible for rendering each menu item, including the logic for setting the title attribute (usually via the 'render' method). To implement an option to remove the title, the 'render' method in 'CascaderMenuItem' is critical, as this is where the title prop would need to be conditionally omitted based on the new API/prop. Both classes are bug-related elements because the solution requires changes to the API surface as well as the rendering logic where the title is applied.
1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario involves a Cascader (multi-level dropdown) component. The screenshot shows that when selecting an option, a tooltip or title attribute appears, displaying the full path of the selection. The user wants an API or prop to disable or remove this title information so that the tooltip does not show up on hover or selection.

2.explanation: The 'title' information (tooltip) is rendered as part of the Cascader menu item, which is controlled in the 'CascaderMenuItem' class in 'src/cascader/item.jsx'. The logic for rendering the menu item, including what props (such as 'title') are applied, resides in the 'render' method. To provide an API to remove or disable the title information, changes would be needed in the 'CascaderMenuItem' class—specifically, the 'render' method, where the title or tooltip is assigned to the rendered menu item. The main Cascader component ('src/cascader/cascader.jsx') would only need changes if new props or options are introduced at the top level, but the actual handling of the title display is done in 'CascaderMenuItem'.
2.bug_scenario: The bug scenario shows the Cascader or Tree component displaying a tooltip or title information (the gray overlay with text) when hovering over menu items, even though the user wants an API to disable or remove this title information. The feature request is to provide an API option to hide or suppress the 'title' attribute that appears as a tooltip on cascader menu items.
